description: T-045's failing input shape: a shipped legacy store plus a sweep pass whose clock sample predates the migration lease the pass triggers the first-read adoption to mint. The pass adopts inside its own document read, so it judges a lease minted milliseconds later with a stamp it sampled before it — 'not yet expired', zero recoveries — and the one-shot migration recovery moves to a later pass instead of landing on the pass that adopted.

observed.test: leaves a live lease alone across a restart, and recovers the same run once
observed.runsUnderLoad: 4 parallel vitest workers of the same suite
